params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Rammus''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} equal to the sum of {{as|15% '''total''' armor}} and {{as|15% '''total''' magic resistance}}.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Rammus}} {{tip|channel|channels}} for a few seconds to roll into a ball, gradually gaining {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}. ''Powerball'' can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards.
params.blurb2: '''Rammus''' stops rolling upon hitting an enemy, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to all nearby enemies and {{tip|airborne|knocking them back}}. Enemies hit are then briefly {{tip|stun|stunned}} and {{tip|slow|slowed}}.
params.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Rammus''' rolls into an accelerating ball, {{tip|channel|channeling}} for up to 6 seconds to gain {{sti|ms|{{pp|key=%|150/6 + (235/6-150/6)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=ms}} {{as|'''bonus total''' movement speed}}}} per second over the duration, up to a maximum of {{pp|key=%|150 + (235-150)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=ms}}.

''Powerball'' can be recast after 1 second within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards or upon casting ''{{ai|Defensive Ball Curl|Rammus}}''.
params.description2: '''Rammus''' stops rolling upon colliding with an enemy, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to all nearby enemies and {{tip|airborne|knocking them back}} 125 units, though not through terrain. Enemies hit are then {{tip|stun|stunned}} and {{tip|standard sight|revealed}} for {{tt|{{fd|0.4}}|Estimated}} seconds, as well as {{tip|slow|slowed}} for 1 second.
params.notes:
* The initial cast and the manual recast count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
** If the ability is not manually recasted, the secondary effect will trigger without being considered as an ability activation.
* The {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} {{tip|stacks multiplicatively}} with other sources of movement speed boosts.
* ''Powerball'' will still collide with enemies if '''Rammus''' is {{tip|ghosted}}.
* For the purpose of moving closer to an enemy when right clicking them, ''Powerball'' also reduces '''Rammus'''' {{as|{{sti|attack range}}}}{{ft|to 0|by 125}}for the duration.
** Regardless of this, during ''Powerball'' '''Rammus''' will also always attempt to path towards his target's center instead.
* '''Rammus''' will ignore [[unit collision]] for the purpose of pathfinding during ''Powerball''.
** Rammus acts as if he were {{tip|ghosted}} for the duration of ''Powerball''.
* ''Powerball'' is not a [[Channel#Movement Channels|movement channel]], and so will not be {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}} by {{tip|root}} and {{tip|ground}}.
* {{tip|Displacement immunity}} will also resist the application of the {{tip|stun}}.
* The following table refers for interactions while '''Rammus''' is {{tip|channel|channeling}}:
{{ct|channel|attack=false|move=true|cast={{ai|Defensive Ball Curl|Rammus}} interrupts. {{ai|Frenzying Taunt|Rammus}} is disabled. {{ai|Soaring Slam|Rammus}} modifies this ability. This ability recasts to end channel.|items=interrupts,true,,false|spells=true,true,interrupts,interrupts,interrupts}}

blurb.plain: Active: Rammus channels for a few seconds to roll into a ball, gradually gaining bonus movement speed. Powerball can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards.

blurb2.plain: Rammus stops rolling upon hitting an enemy, dealing magic damage to all nearby enemies and knocking them back. Enemies hit are then briefly stunned and slowed.

description.plain: Active: Rammus rolls into an accelerating ball, channeling for up to 6 seconds to gain ⟦pp⟧ bonus total movement speed per second over the duration, up to a maximum of ⟦pp⟧. Powerball can be recast after 1 second within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards or upon casting Defensive Ball Curl.

description2.plain: Rammus stops rolling upon colliding with an enemy, dealing magic damage to all nearby enemies and knocking them back 125 units, though not through terrain. Enemies hit are then stunned and revealed for 0.4 seconds, as well as slowed for 1 second.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Rammus}} enters a defensive stance for a few seconds, gaining {{sti|armor|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{sti|mr|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resist}}}}. During this time, enemies that land a basic attack against '''Rammus''' are dealt {{as|magic damage}}.
params.blurb2: ''Defensive Ball Curl'' can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterward.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rammus''' enters a defensive stance for 7 seconds, gaining {{sti|armor|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{sti|mr|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}}. While active, enemies that use a basic attack {{tip|on-hit}} against '''Rammus''' are dealt {{as|15|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 10% '''total''' armor)}} {{as|(+ 10% '''total''' magic resistance)}} {{as|magic damage}}.
params.leveling:
{{st|Bonus Armor|{{ap|25 to 45}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30 to 50}}% '''total''' armor)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Magic Resistance|{{ap|20 to 40}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30 to 50}}% '''total''' magic resistance)}}}}
params.description2: ''Defensive Ball Curl'' can be recast after 1 second within the duration, and does so automatically upon casting ''{{ai|Powerball|Rammus}}'' or ''{{ai|Soaring Slam|Rammus}}''.
params.notes:
*The initial cast counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
**Deactivating the ability manually does not.
* ''Defensive Ball Curl'' ends immediately if {{ai|Powerball|Rammus}} is cast.
* ''Defensive Ball Curl'' will return damage from attacks and/or abilities that apply [[on-hit effect]]s ({{ai|Mystic Shot|Ezreal}}) as well as from {{iis|Runaan's Hurricane}} {{nie|Wind's Fury}} (will not return damage from [[turret]]s, {{ai|H-28G Evolution Turret|Heimerdinger}}, or {{ai|Jack in the Box|Shaco}}).
* ''Defensive Ball Curl's'' total resistances and {{bi|Mountainous Vigor}} {{tip|stacks multiplicatively|stack multiplicatively}}
** The ability's bonus {{as|armor}} and {{as|magic resist}} flat components are scaled by {{iis|Jak'Sho, The Protean}} {{nie|Voidborn Resilience}}, and combined with the total resists (excluding the stats from {{bi|Mountainous Vigor}}) multiplied by the ability's percentage total resistances increase. The resulting total bonus stats are then multiplied by {{bi|Mountainous Vigor}}.
* The resistances gained from ''Defensive Ball Curl's'' will recalculate over the duration.

blurb.plain: Active: Rammus enters a defensive stance for a few seconds, gaining bonus armor and bonus magic resist. During this time, enemies that land a basic attack against Rammus are dealt magic damage.

blurb2.plain: Defensive Ball Curl can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterward.

blurb3.plain: Recast: Rammus ends Defensive Ball Curl.

description.plain: Active: Rammus enters a defensive stance for 7 seconds, gaining bonus armor and bonus magic resistance. While active, enemies that use a basic attack on-hit against Rammus are dealt 15 (+ 10% total armor) (+ 10% total magic resistance) magic damage.

description2.plain: Defensive Ball Curl can be recast after 1 second within the duration, and does so automatically upon casting Powerball or Soaring Slam.

description3.plain: Recast: Rammus ends Defensive Ball Curl.

{{st|Monster Magic Damage|{{ap|80 to 160}} {{as|(+ 70% AP)}}}}

blurb.plain: Active: Rammus briefly taunts the target enemy champion or monster.

blurb2.plain: Additionally deals magic damage against monsters.

description.plain: Active: Rammus taunts the target enemy champion or monster for a duration. Monsters are additionally dealt magic damage upon being affected.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Rammus}} {{tip|dash|leaps}} to the target location with {{tip|Cc-immunity}}, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and briefly {{tip|slow|slowing}} them.
params.blurb2: ''Soaring Slam'' gains increased {{sti|range}} based on '''Rammus'''' {{sti|movement speed}}. '''Rammus''' can cast this ability during ''{{ai|Powerball|Rammus}}'', which will additionally {{tip|airborne|knock up}} enemies in the epicenter.
params.blurb3: ''Soaring Slam's'' damage affects {{tip|structures}} and is doubled against {{tip|turrets}}.
params.blurb4: {{sbc|{{tip|Cc-immunity|nolink=true}}}}: {{tip|Crowd control}} cannot be applied during this time.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rammus''' {{tip|dash|leaps}} to the target location with {{tip|Cc-immunity|immunity to crowd control}}. Upon arrival, he creates an impact that deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|slow|slows}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
params.description2: If ''Soaring Slam'' was cast during ''{{ai|Powerball|Rammus}}'', enemies within the epicenter of the impact are also {{tip|airborne|knocked up}} for {{fd|0.75}} seconds and are dealt ''{{ais|Powerball|Rammus}}'' damage. ''{{ai|Powerball|Rammus}}'' will not collide with enemies during the dash, and its channel will be maintained for the dash and end afterwards.
params.description3: The impact causes 3 aftershocks to burst from the area over {{fd|3.5}} seconds, each one applying and refreshing the duration of the initial {{tip|slow}}.
params.description4: ''Soaring Slam's'' damage affects {{tip|structures}} and is doubled against {{tip|turrets}}.
params.target range: {{tt|800|Base maximum dash distance}} OR {{tt|{{as|150% movement speed}}|Maximum dash distance based on the average of this percentage of movement speed in the last second, overrides the base maximum dash distance if the value is greater than 800 (see notes). Updates every 0.25 seconds.}}<!--has a minimum dash range, needs to be measured-->
params.speed: {{dv|{{tt|900|Minimum dash speed}}|{{tt|2000|Maximum dash speed}}}}<!--Dash speed growth is 110%-->
params.inner radius: {{tt|200|Impact epicenter radius when cast with Powerball}}
params.notes:
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will block the impact (including with {{ai|Powerball|Rammus}}) but not each aftershock.
* '''Rammus''' is required to have at least {{as|{{fd|461.5}} '''total''' movement speed}} ''average'' over the last second to be able to cast ''Soaring Slam'' further than its base maximum dash range (>800 units).
* ''Soaring Slam'' will not impact nor generate aftershocks if the dash is interrupted.

blurb.plain: Active: Rammus leaps to the target location with Cc-immunity, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies and briefly slowing them.

blurb2.plain: Soaring Slam gains increased range based on Rammus' movement speed. Rammus can cast this ability during Powerball, which will additionally knock up enemies in the epicenter.

blurb3.plain: Soaring Slam's damage affects structures and is doubled against turrets.

blurb4.plain: Cc-immunity: Crowd control cannot be applied during this time.

description.plain: Active: Rammus leaps to the target location with immunity to crowd control. Upon arrival, he creates an impact that deals magic damage to nearby enemies and slows them for 1.5 seconds.

description2.plain: If Soaring Slam was cast during Powerball, enemies within the epicenter of the impact are also knocked up for 0.75 seconds and are dealt Powerball damage. Powerball will not collide with enemies during the dash, and its channel will be maintained for the dash and end afterwards.

description3.plain: The impact causes 3 aftershocks to burst from the area over 3.5 seconds, each one applying and refreshing the duration of the initial slow.

description4.plain: Soaring Slam's damage affects structures and is doubled against turrets.
